"""Migrated Meridian CRM case lifecycle workflow."""

from typing import Any, Callable, TypeAlias

Record: TypeAlias = dict[str, Any]
Guard: TypeAlias = Callable[[Record], bool]
Action: TypeAlias = tuple[str, str, str | None]
Transition: TypeAlias = tuple[str, str, str, Guard | None, tuple[Action, ...]]


def _nonempty(field: str) -> Guard:
    return lambda record: record.get(field, "") != ""


def _not_equal(field: str, value: str) -> Guard:
    return lambda record: record.get(field, "") != value


_TRANSITIONS: tuple[Transition, ...] = (
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "assign",
        _nonempty("OWNER_UID"),
        (("audit", "CASE_ASSIGN", None),),
    ),
    (
        "N",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        None,
        (
            ("set_literal", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("set_nvl", "SEV_CD", "3"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "A",
        "auto_escalate",
        _not_equal("ESC_FLG", "Y"),
        (
            ("set_literal", "ESC_FLG", "Y"),
            ("audit", "CASE_ESC", None),
            ("notify", "escalation", None),
        ),
    ),
    (
        "A",
        "P",
        "await_customer",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_PEND", None),),
    ),
    ("P", "A", "customer_reply", None, ()),
    (
        "A",
        "R",
        "resolve",
        _not_equal("RES_DT", "00000000"),
        (("audit", "CASE_RES", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "X",
        "close",
        None,
        (("audit", "CASE_CLOSE", None),),
    ),
    (
        "R",
        "A",
        "reopen",
        None,
        (
            ("set_literal", "RES_DT", "00000000"),
            ("audit", "CASE_REOPEN", None),
        ),
    ),
)


def fire(state: str, event: str, record: dict) -> dict:
    """Dispatch an explicit event against the case lifecycle workflow."""
    updated_record = dict(record)

    for from_state, to_state, transition_event, guard, actions in _TRANSITIONS:
        if from_state != state or transition_event != event:
            continue
        if guard is not None and not guard(updated_record):
            continue

        audits: list[str] = []
        notifies: list[str] = []

        for action_type, name, value in actions:
            if action_type == "set_literal":
                updated_record[name] = value
            elif action_type == "set_nvl":
                current = updated_record.get(name, "")
                updated_record[name] = value if current == "" else current
            elif action_type == "audit":
                audits.append(name)
            elif action_type == "notify":
                notifies.append(name)

        return {
            "state": to_state,
            "record": updated_record,
            "audits": audits,
            "notifies": notifies,
            "matched": True,
        }

    return {
        "state": state,
        "record": updated_record,
        "audits": ["WF_NOMATCH"],
        "notifies": [],
        "matched": False,
    }
